description: Systematic audit and enforcement of module layer boundaries. Architecture doc: 'No cross-dependencies - modules communicate through defined interfaces only.' Layers: storage/ (DB access), repositories/ (data access abstraction), services/ (business logic), fetcher/ (RSS fetching), controllers/ (HTTP), websocket/ (real-time). Verify no layer skips its adjacent layer. Supersedes empty epic quickhea-v6m.
title: Enforce layer boundaries and remove cross-dependencies
